nodes.summary: Let $g : \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}$ be twice continuously differentiable. If $g$ has a local minimum at $x$, then $g''(x) \ge 0$.
nodes.title: The second derivative is nonnegative at a local minimum

nodes.summary: For $f : \mathbb{R}^n \to \mathbb{R}$, a point $x \in \mathbb{R}^n$ and indices $i, j$, the $(i, j)$ entry of the Hessian matrix of $f$ at $x$ is $\frac{d}{ds}\big|_{s=0} \frac{d}{dt}\big|_{t=0} f(x + s e_i + t e_j)$, where $e_1, \dots, e_n$ is the standard basis of $\mathbb{R}^n$ and a derivative that does not exist is taken to be $0$: differentiate first along $e_j$, then along $e_i$.
nodes.title: Entries of the Hessian matrix

nodes.summary: Let $f : \mathbb{R}^n \to \mathbb{R}$ be twice continuously differentiable and let $x \in \mathbb{R}^n$. For all indices $i, j$, the $(i, j)$ entry of the Hessian matrix of $f$ at $x$ equals $D(Df)(x)(e_i)(e_j)$, the derivative of the Fréchet derivative $Df$ at $x$ in the direction $e_i$, applied to $e_j$, where $e_1, \dots, e_n$ is the standard basis of $\mathbb{R}^n$.
nodes.title: Hessian entries as second Fréchet derivatives

nodes.summary: If $f : \mathbb{R}^n \to \mathbb{R}$ is twice continuously differentiable, then for every $x \in \mathbb{R}^n$ the Hessian matrix of $f$ at $x$ is symmetric: it equals its transpose.
nodes.title: Symmetry of the Hessian

nodes.summary: For a function $f : \mathbb{R}^n \to \mathbb{R}$ and a point $x \in \mathbb{R}^n$, the Hessian matrix of $f$ at $x$ is the $n \times n$ real matrix whose $(i, j)$ entry is $\frac{d}{ds}\big|_{s=0} \frac{d}{dt}\big|_{t=0} f(x + s e_i + t e_j)$, where $e_1, \dots, e_n$ is the standard basis of $\mathbb{R}^n$ and a derivative that does not exist is taken to be $0$.
nodes.title: Hessian matrix

nodes.summary: Let $f : \mathbb{R}^n \to \mathbb{R}$ be twice continuously differentiable and let $x$ be a local minimum of $f$. Then the Hessian quadratic form of $f$ at $x$ is nonnegative: writing $H$ for the Hessian matrix of $f$ at $x$, every $v \in \mathbb{R}^n$ satisfies $\sum_{i, j} v_i H_{ij} v_j \ge 0$.
nodes.title: Second-derivative test, necessary condition

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
